units.source_text: 常陆守答道：“少将有这意思，我实不曾详悉。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi replied, "I was not fully aware that the Lesser Captain had such intentions.

units.source_text: 对于这个女儿，我实在应当同别的女儿一样看待。

en.t: As for this daughter, I ought in truth to have treated her the same as my other daughters.

units.source_text: 然而家里庸碌的子女甚多，我身能力有限，一一照顾，势难周到。

en.t: But there are many ordinary children in my household, and my own abilities are limited, so even when I try to care for each one, I cannot do so thoroughly.

units.source_text: 其间夫人就多心起来，说我歧视此女，把她当作外人。

en.t: Meanwhile my wife became suspicious and said that I was slighting this girl and treating her as an outsider.

units.source_text: 因此关于此女之事，都不容我插嘴。

en.t: Because of that, she would not allow me to say a word about anything concerning this girl.

units.source_text: 少将求婚之事，我也略有所闻。

en.t: I had also heard a little about the Lesser Captain's proposal.

units.source_text: 但对我如此看重，我却一向不知。

en.t: But I had never known that he valued me so highly.

units.source_text: 他要和我攀亲，我实不胜欣幸。

en.t: If he wishes to form a family tie with me, I am truly overjoyed beyond measure.

units.source_text: 我有一个非常疼爱的女儿。

en.t: I have one daughter whom I love very dearly.

units.source_text: 在许多女儿之中，我最爱此人，情愿为她舍命。

en.t: Among all my daughters, I love this one most, and I would gladly give my life for her.

units.source_text: 曾有数人前来求婚，但我观今世之人性行浮薄，深恐早为定亲，反而使她受苦，因此概不答应。

en.t: Several men once came to ask for her hand, but seeing how frivolous people in this world are, I feared that arranging a match too early would only make her suffer, and so I refused them all.

units.source_text: 正在日夜筹思，总想找个稳重可靠的女婿。

en.t: Day and night I have been thinking it over, always hoping to find a steady and dependable son-in-law.

units.source_text: 讲起这位少将，我年轻时曾在他老太爷大将大人麾下供职。

en.t: As for this Lesser Captain, when I was young I served under his grandfather, the great General.

units.source_text: 那时我以家臣身份拜见这位少将，觉得真是一个英俊少年，私心倾慕，情愿为他服务。

en.t: At that time I met this Lesser Captain as a retainer, thought him a truly handsome young man, admired him privately, and wished to serve him.

units.source_text: 但因后来远赴外地任职，多年不返，遂致日渐生疏，久未登门拜访。

en.t: But later I went far away to take up an outside post and did not return for many years, so we gradually grew distant, and I have not visited his house for a long time.

units.source_text: 今闻少将有此志望，使我诚惶诚恐，不胜感激。

en.t: Now that I hear the Lesser Captain has such a wish, I am deeply humbled and endlessly grateful.

units.source_text: 所谈之事不成问题。

en.t: There is no problem at all with the matter you have discussed.

units.source_text: 只是改变了少将原来的计划，生怕夫人怀恨，如是奈何？”

en.t: Only, since this would change the Lesser Captain's original plan, I fear my wife may bear a grudge; what should be done about that?"

units.source_text: 这番话说得非常周详。

en.t: He expressed all this with great thoroughness.

units.source_text: 媒人看见大事已定，不胜欣喜，说道：“此事不须担心。

en.t: Seeing that the important matter was settled, the matchmaker was delighted and said, "There is no need to worry about this.

units.source_text: 少将只指望您一人许诺。

en.t: The Lesser Captain hopes only for your consent.

units.source_text: 他说：‘即使年齿尚幼，只要是亲生父母所疼爱的，便符合我的本意。

en.t: He said, 'Even if she is still young, as long as she is cherished by her own parents, that accords with my true wish.

units.source_text: 只是勉强追随，迹近谄媚，则非我所愿。’

en.t: Merely following along under pressure, in a way that approaches flattery, is not what I desire.'

units.source_text: 这位少将人品高贵，声望优越。

en.t: This Lesser Captain is noble in character and exceptional in reputation.

units.source_text: 虽是青年贵公子，全无骄奢淫逸之气，却是深通人情世故。

en.t: Although he is a young nobleman, he has none of the air of arrogance, extravagance, or dissipation, and instead understands human feelings and worldly affairs deeply.

units.source_text: 领地庄园甚多，到处皆是。

en.t: He has many estates and manors, spread everywhere.

units.source_text: 目下虽然收入尚少，然而自有优裕的家世，远胜于暴富得势的寻常人。

en.t: Although his income is still modest at present, he comes from a prosperous family, far superior to ordinary people who have suddenly gained wealth and power.

units.source_text: 他来年一定晋爵四位。

en.t: Next year he will certainly be promoted to the Fourth Rank.

units.source_text: 此次升任天皇侍从长无疑，这是今上亲口说的。

en.t: There is no doubt that he will now be promoted to chief chamberlain to the Emperor; His Majesty said so himself.

units.source_text: 今上说道：‘这朝臣富有才能，全无缺陷，何以至今尚无妻室？

en.t: His Majesty said, 'This courtier is rich in talent and has no faults at all, so why does he still have no wife?

units.source_text: 应即选定一岳丈作为后援人才是。

en.t: He should immediately choose a father-in-law to serve as his backer.

units.source_text: 此人不日即可升至公卿之位，有我在此，可保无虞。’

en.t: This man will soon rise to the rank of court noble, and with me here, I can guarantee there will be nothing to fear.'

units.source_text: 皇上身旁一切事务，均由这少将一人承办。

en.t: All matters at the Emperor's side are handled by this Lesser Captain alone.

units.source_text: 只因此君性情非常机警，故能担当重大任务。

en.t: It is precisely because this gentleman is so quick-witted by nature that he can shoulder such important duties.

units.source_text: 如此难得的乘龙佳婿，自动先来求婚，大人务须从速定夺才好。

en.t: Such a rare and excellent son-in-law has come forward of his own accord to propose first, so my lord must decide quickly.

units.source_text: 因为少将府上，欲得他为婿而前来说亲的人甚多，这里如果犹豫不决，他就向别处定亲了。

en.t: Many people come to the Lesser Captain's house seeking to have him as a son-in-law, so if you hesitate here, he will become engaged elsewhere.

units.source_text: 我是专为贵府利益而前来说亲的。”

en.t: I have come to propose this match solely for the benefit of your house."

units.source_text: 此人信口开河，说了一大套甜言蜜语。

en.t: This man spoke recklessly, pouring out a long stream of honeyed words.

units.source_text: 常陆守原是个非常鄙俗的田舍翁，满面笑容地听他说罢，然后答道：“目下收入尚少之话，全然不须谈及。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was in fact a very vulgar country old man; after listening with a broad smile, he replied, "There is no need at all to mention that his present income is still small.

units.source_text: 只要我生存在世，一定全力照顾，不要说捧在掌上，捧到头顶上我也乐意，哪里会叫他感到缺乏呢？

en.t: As long as I am alive, I will certainly take care of him with all my strength; far from merely holding him in my palm, I would gladly raise him above my head, so how could I ever let him feel any lack?

units.source_text: 即使我中途死去，不能照顾到底，我所留下来的宝物和各处领地庄园，全归此女所有，无人敢来争夺。

en.t: Even if I die along the way and cannot care for him to the end, all the treasures I leave behind, along with my estates and manors everywhere, will belong to this daughter, and no one will dare dispute them.

units.source_text: 我家虽有许多子女，但此女从小就是我所特别疼爱的。

en.t: Although my household has many children, this girl has been the one I especially cherished since she was small.

units.source_text: 但得少将真心爱护她，即使他要使尽珍珠宝贝去求取大臣之位，我也能供应无缺。

en.t: If only the Lesser Captain truly loves and protects her, then even if he needs to exhaust pearls and treasures to seek a minister's rank, I can supply him without shortage.

units.source_text: 当今皇上如此看得起他，我做他的后援人可保无虑了。

en.t: Since the present Emperor holds him in such high regard, I can safely become his backer without concern.

units.source_text: 这件亲事，为少将计，为小女计，都是幸福之事。

en.t: This marriage will be a fortunate thing both for the Lesser Captain and for my daughter.

units.source_text: 你说对么？”

en.t: Wouldn't you agree?"

units.source_text: 媒人听见常陆守说得兴高采烈，非常欢喜，也不把此事告诉他妹妹，也不到浮舟母女处告辞，立刻赴少将邸内去了。

en.t: When the matchmaker heard the Governor of Hitachi speak so exuberantly, he was very pleased; without telling his sister about it or going to bid farewell to Ukifune and her mother, he immediately went to the Lesser Captain's residence.
